label: late original-phase positions (input step 6-8)
explanation: Positional feature: fires only on the original (input) phase at absolute positions t >= 5, essentially never on <DEL> or copy steps and never at t <= 4. Rate is ~8% at t=5 and ~50-60% at t=6..8, which hold ~96% of activation mass; so it only appears in long sequences (L >= 7 carries ~99% of mass). Within those positions it fires on roughly half the steps; the gating is diffuse token/history dependence (slightly higher after e, c, x, v, n inputs, on first occurrences, and with more digits), but no simple token predicate improved F1. Magnitude rises with position (largest activations at t=7-8 near the end of the original sequence).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: e, c, x, v, n, f; least: i, g, 2, p) and the current input token (most: z, x, e, w, g, j; least: r, a, p, d); timing cues that raise it most: t=6, t=7, L=9 & t=7.
